lines.text: The writer rejoices that the Philippians revived their concern for him and says he has learned to be content.
The writer says he can do all things through Christ, and the Philippians did well to share in his affliction.
No other church partnered with him in giving and receiving, and in Corinth the Philippians supported him again and again.
He received the Philippians' gifts from Barnabas and says God will supply all their needs according to His glorious riches.
All the saints send greetings, especially those from the household of Caesar.
